rows: A random safe land location, Creative mode and flight.
Survival mode; the generated person's body, name, tribe, family links, languages and knowledge. Held items follow the same rules as NPC props.

blocks.text: The controlled resident is excluded from NPC spawning. Their identity survives leaving for the world simulation and saving/reloading. Some residents naturally have empty hands; there is no universal starter bag.
Childhood and dialogue are not part of this prototype.

rows: A physical human actor; grey indicates a corpse.
A camp site. Dim markers have not been physically loaded.
A community and its total population. Dim means coarse projection; nearby groups have local schedules.

blocks.text: The plot extends to 50 km and retains the expanded near-field scale and animal range rings. Human markers read the existing local simulation; opening the radar does not create another global NPC simulation.

Checks passed: 108 Core identity, deterministic-selection, equipment and serialization assertions; 28 packaged-game assertions covering both starts, tribe presence, no duplicate resident, family links, radar, HUD bounds and resuming the same person. No new performance claim is made from this check.
